articleTitle: Silicon Non-Volatile Optical Memory and All-Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel silicon non-volatile optical memory fabricated using standard silicon photonics processes. It demonstrates a non-volatile wavelength shift of up to ~ 42 pm, resulting in an optical power difference of ~ 18dB, and supports 26 distinct states. This optical memory can be seamlessly integrated into silicon photonic integrated circuits, providing a straightforward and cost-effective all-silicon photonic solution.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Optical Filters on an Integrated Si3N4 PIC Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper describes the procedure to design and realize optical filters in the ultra-low loss silicon nitride TriPleX PIC technology. A realized lattice filter with free spectral range of 160 GHz was characterized where the order of the filter was tuned from one to nine.

articleTitle: A 32-Input Integrated Coherent Combiner
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Free space optics enables high data rate satellite communications but suffers from turbulence-induced losses. A coherent combiner for a turbulence mitigation scheme is presented and characterised, based on a 32-input photonic integrated circuit on a low-loss, thick SOI open platform offered by VTT.

articleTitle: 100 Gbit/s Quantum-Confined Stark Effect Electro-Optic Modulator Integrated with SiN Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a Ge/SiGe quantum-confined Stark effect modulator integrated with SiN waveguides. The modulator has a >4.5 dB static and a 3 dB dynamic extinction ratio of 50 Gb/s. A record 100 Gb/s on-off keying modulation is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: 800G Transmission at 100W Output Power - Assessing the Feasibility of Optical Satellite Feeder Links
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present advancements in free-space optical communication for satellite-ground networks. Using advanced atmospheric-turbulence-mitigation techniques, we tested new modulation formats at low-received optical powers at data rates of up to 1Tbit/s and transmitted output powers of up to 100 Watts across linear, free-space links of up to 53km.

articleTitle: Gas-Stop Design Towards Low-Loss Connection for Reliable Hollow-Core Fiber Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A gas-stop is designed to enable low-loss and hermetic connection between hollow-core fibers. This design enhances robustness of hollow-core fiber networks as it provides efficient connectivity and prevents fiber degradation when it comes to fiber interruption. Furthermore, the proposed gas-stop allows real-time distributed fiber characterization.

articleTitle: Compact and Thermally-Robust Offset-QAM Optical Transmitters Using RAMZI Modulators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Energy- and area-efficient coherent optical transmitters are essential for achieving higher data rates in future co-packaged optics (CPO) systems. In this paper, we address this by proposing an offset-QAM transmitter with high optical power tolerance using MRMs in ring-assisted MZI (RAMZI) structures.

articleTitle: Silica-Based Planar Lightwave Circuit Switch on a Cavity Structure for Reducing Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A thermo-optic switch using a silica-based planar lightwave circuit formed on cavity structure using fabrication process of cavity silicon on insulator (Cavity SOI) is proposed for reducing power consumption. The power consumption was successfully reduced by approximately half due to this structure.

articleTitle: FSOC Optical Ground Segment Developments in Australasia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This presentation outlines our research in free space optical communications (FSOC) and the development of quantum-encrypted systems. We review the operation of FSOC ground stations in Europe and Australasia. We aim to integrate our prototype FSOC observatory with a locally produced quantum memory.

articleTitle: 10 Gbps Transmission from a High Power EDFA for Free Space Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a source for free-space optical communications capable of single-channel high data rate transmission (10 Gbps) from a high power EDFA at 1553.33 nm (193 THz). At an output power of 80 W the bit error rate (BER) shows no power penalty compared to a back-to-back measurement. Additionally, we demonstrate narrow linewidth and DWDM performance. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Phased Arrays for AR Displays, Biophotonics, 3D Printing, and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Integrated optical-phased-array-based platforms, devices, and systems for applications in augmented-reality displays, LiDAR sensing for autonomous vehicles, optical trapping for biophotonics, chip-based 3D printing, and trapped-ion quantum engineering will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Optical Signal Delay Processor for a Beamforming Antenna in a Radio over Fiber System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical signal delay processor for a beamforming antenna in a radio over fiber system is fabricated. The relative delay between four optical signals is controlled from 0 to 31.2 ps, corresponding to the phase control from 0 to 7p/4 for 28-GHz radio wave.

articleTitle: General-Purpose Programmable Photonic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Programmable photonic circuits bring much-needed flexibility to the world of integrated optics, making it possible to engineer more diverse functions on a single chip, and accelerate prototyping photonics for new applications. We will discuss recent progress in general-purpose programmable chip technology and the surrounding ecosystem.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Integrated Photonics for Energy-Efficient AI Hardware
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The convergence of deep learning models and the availability of large datasets has spurred significant interest in developing new hardware that can run AI algorithms more energy-efficiently. At Hewlett Packard Labs, we've developed an energy-efficient silicon photonics platform, a foundational technology for next-generation AI hardware.

articleTitle: Realizing PIC-Based 1×N Flexible WaveBand-Selective Switches in SiN Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We posit that traffic management in future high-capacity networks employing ultra-wideband and spatially-diverse links will require a key new switching device, the flexible WaveBand-Selective Switch, placed hierarchically with existing optical switching technologies. The challenges for its realization in integrated platform are considered.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Raman Amplification for Ultra-Wideband Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review recent advances in the design of ultrawideband Raman amplifiers, describe their application in highcapacity transmission systems, and discuss their potential application in ultra-wideband optical networks.

articleTitle: Modeling Many-body Effects in Ge Using Pump-Probe Femtosecond Ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate the transient dielectric function of germanium at very high electron-hole pair densities using time-resolved spectroscopic ellipsometry. By employing a pump-probe technique, we examine how the parameters of the critical points near the L-valley evolve with delay time. Our analysis aims to develop a model describing the behavior of the material under varying carrier concentrations, with particular attention to phase-filling singularities. We leverage high-power laser-induced carriers in undoped samples to explore many-body effects and relaxation processes.

articleTitle: Identifying Activity along a Subsea Fibre Path Connecting an Offshore Installation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: State of Polarisation (SoP) patterns have been observed during a six-month period revealing activity along a subsea cable and the cable landing path to the node room. Subsea activities show different SoP patterns than work in node rooms and manholes.

articleTitle: Photonic Integration in the Era of SDM: Techniques, Opportunities, and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This study explores the synergies between Spatial Division Multiplexing and photonic integration, investigating how the strategic implementation of photonic design and packaging techniques aligns to enhance the die edge density (Gbps/mm).

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Functionalities and Single Photon Detection for Integrated Quantum Photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate crucial components for integrated quantum photonics, such as phase shifters, modulators, sub-wavelength grating structures, and a wide range of compact nanophotonic devices based on inverse design, as well as waveguide-integrated superconducting nanowire single photon detectors enabling novel communication, sensing and information processing implementations.

articleTitle: On Intelligent Inverse-Design: Optimizing Compact Integrated Photonic Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-compact optimization maintaining strict fabricability by experimentally validating a record size 2.5×3 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> topology optimized integrated photonic modal multiplexer with insertion losses of <1dB (<2.7dB) for the TE0 (TE1) mode, and >20.7dB extinction.

articleTitle: 20 Gb/s Free Space Data Transmission with 980 nm Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Via standard nonreturn-to-zero two-level pulse amplitude modulation we achieve record single channel bit rates of 20 to 30 gigabits-per-second across free space with a 7-element top-emitting 980 nm vertical cavity surface emitting laser array – an enabling step toward energy-efficient Next Generation optical wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Projection Measurement-Based Optical Sensing Satisfying Superresolution of Quantum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Due to the single-photon regime sacrificing signal-to-noise ratio, quantum sensors have been severely limited to practical applications. Here, classically excited superresolution is presented for the new realm of quantum sensors compatible with conventional sensing metrologies based on interferometers and lasers or electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Dielectric Metasurface for Surface-Normal Optical IQ Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We design, fabricate, and demonstrate a dielectric metasurface that can be combined with an intensity modulator array to realize high-speed and highly-parallelized dualpolarization IQ modulator. Metasurface with silicon nanoposts is fabricated to demonstrate required beam/polarizationsplitting functionalities with a phase error of less than 0.12 rad.

articleTitle: Achieving Multiple-Day Stability in a Single-Cavity Dual Comb Laser for Spectroscopic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A portable ring cavity fiber laser that generates two stable orthogonally polarized vector solitons for over 125 hours. Featuring an Allan deviation of 0.0002319 Hz/s and a single sideband (SSB) phase noise of −95 dBc/Hz at an offset of 100 Hz.

articleTitle: Multiport O-Band Dynamic Optical Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We designed, fabricated, and tested a 16-port wave-length equalizing dynamic optical filter with a circulator, supporting 13.6THz O-Band (1240-1348nm) transmission. The device showed an insertion loss from 4-7dB for most ports, with all ports maintaining an insertion loss below 8dB and extinction ratio exceeding 35dB.

articleTitle: Amplitude and Phase Matching Structure for Twin-Photon Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: An original solution with 5% efficiency and 0.3 nm linewidth for spontaneous-parametric down-conversion in 2 mm long semiconductor waveguides is proposed. The simultaneous amplitude and phase-matching in the transverse and propagation directions, respectively results in the efficient utilisation of the entire nonlinear volume.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integrated Photonic Arbitrary Waveform Generator for Single-Atom Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Integrated photonic arbitrary waveform generators allow significant advancements in scalability and performance of single qubit addressing in neutral atom quantum computers. In this work, we showcase a hybrid Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N4/LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> electro-optic circuit for single-atom controll, achieving switching speeds surpassing 15 GHz bandwidth and 50 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Potential of Multi-Band WDM Transmission through Wavelength Band Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Extending the optical spectrum beyond the C+L band addresses escalating capacity demands in deployed fiber infrastructures. Wavelength converters enable extended band utilization by overcoming wavelength constraints. This paper reviews inter-band wavelength conversion technologies and their application in multi-band wavelength-division multiplexing system.

articleTitle: Optical Interchannel Interference in Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review the effects of crosstalk and other channel-to-channel optical interference in Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing systems. We show that this interference is a major phenomenon in such systems designed for full capacity and discuss device, circuit and architecture-level methods for mitigating its effects.

articleTitle: Telecommunications Fiber for Sensing Earthquake Aftershocks: Progress and Hurdles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Aftershocks offer valuable clues to earthquake behavior. The challenge: quickly deploying sensors to capture the early details of earthquake ruptures within the zone of aftershocks. Telecommunication fibers might be an answer, providing denser networks in otherwise difficult areas, potentially faster than traditional methods.

articleTitle: The Silent Threat: Acoustic Sensitivity of Indoor Optical Cables and Its Security Implications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Fibre-optic cables within buildings pose a potential security risk as they can function as microphones, capturing human speech. In this article, we address the assessment of various types of single-mode and multi-mode cables, and their susceptibility to picking up acoustic vibrations within the audible spectrum.

articleTitle: Simplification of Edge Network Architecture with Open Packet Switches and Pluggable Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper reports and demonstrates a packetponder for access/metro node consolidation and aggregation using common-form-factor pluggables (CFFP), which can simplify edg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup> network architectures.

articleTitle: Comparative Numerical Analysis of Photonic Integrated Tunable Optoelectronic Oscillators Employing High-Q Optical Cavities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The performance of two hybrid integrated widely tunable optoelectronic oscillator schemes employing low loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microring resonators are compared through computer aided numerical simulation analyses. Optimal device, cavity parameters, and operating conditions leading to enhanced phase noise performance are investigated.

articleTitle: Parallel Photonic Matrix Processor Based on Space and Wavelength Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We show our recent progress for scaling-up the optical computing engine using silica-based waveguide technology and its combination with free-space-optics (FSO). Owing to the dense parallelization in both space and wavelength division, our device can improve computational speed to sub-peta OPS scale.

articleTitle: Universal Unitary Transformations on a Programmable Integrated Photonic Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We show how hexagonal programmable photonic processors can implement different linear transformation. We experimentally measure <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\times3$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\times4$</tex> unitary matrices on a hexagonal mesh, achieving fidelities of 98.4% and 96.7%, and a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r^{2}$</tex> of 0.99 and 0.95 when comparing the measured and applied weights,

articleTitle: Coherent Transceiver Architecture Enabling Data Transmission and Optical Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a coherent transceiver architecture able to transmit information and enhance the security of the optical network by identifying other optical systems and sub-systems. Simulations show that identification is obtained with sufficient reliability-probability of false positive and negative below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> -in standard operating conditions

articleTitle: On the Limits of Multimode SDM Transmission Capacity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review our recent work on the optimization of multimode fibers to support over 1000 spatial modes, focusing on minimizing differential mode delay and maximizing throughput. We identify a practical mode scaling limit due to Rayleigh scattering, macro-bend loss and coating loss.

articleTitle: Design of Horseshoe Networks with Low-Loss Filterless Nodes and Point-to-Multipoint Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Point-to-multipoint coherent transceivers are an efficient solution to support the hub-and-spoke traffic pattern that is present in metro-aggregation networks. This paper proposes to combine the utilization of these transceivers in horseshoe networks with the use of a node architecture based on 2-by-2 couplers and customized deployment of pre-amplifiers. A mathematical model to minimize the total number of required amplifiers is detailed and used to evaluate the pros and cons of this architecture compared to common ones based on pairing 1-by-2 splitters and combiners.

articleTitle: Coherent and Incoherent Noise Cancellation Using Distributed Optical Fiber Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper determines the sensitivity of distributed optical fiber sensors by estimating its self-noise and describing how to cancel coherent and incoherent noises, and localize sources based entirely on the sensor recordings.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Compute-In-Memory Architecture for 3D Opto-Electronic Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We introduce a hyperspectral compute-in-memory architecture that simultaneously utilizes the frequency and space dimensions for single-shot matrix-matrix multiplication. This approach offers remarkable parallelism, scalability, programmability, and efficient use of chip area, enabling a compute density greater than PetaOPS/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>• The architecture shows potential for energy-efficient, three-dimensional opto-electronic computing in future data center applications.

articleTitle: High-Speed Energy Efficient Optics for AI/ML Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: High-speed energy efficient optics are reviewed with recent progress. High efficiency linear-driver optics with silicon photonics show promising in pluggable modules with high performances and active optical cables (AOC) with low power by design optimization and trade-off between performances and power for Al/ML applications.

articleTitle: Sodium Guidestar Lasers and Fiber Amplifiers for Optical Satellite Uplinks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Recent progress in the development of Sodium Guide Star laser technology have brought day-time space observation and optical satellite uplink correction with adaptive optics into reach. Using well understood advanced quantum excitation schemes and higher overall optical output power increases the return-flux of the artificial star. Moreover, we report on the development of erbium-doped large mode fiber amplifier technology, intra-band-pumped by Raman shifted 1480 nm fiber lasers. These amplifiers can boost the output power of satellite uplink communication lasers beyond 20W average power without limitations due to nonlinear effects like SPM or SBS, typically occurring in optical fibers at high power levels.

articleTitle: Characterization of Dimerized Plasmonic Grating for Reflective Electro-Optic Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a surface-normal modulator using a dimerized plasmonic grating-based resonator embedded with electro-optic polymer. Efficient modulation with >20 dB extinction ratio is demonstrated numerically with < 1-µm-thick device. Designed structures are fabricated to demonstrate continuous tuning of the Q factor by tuning the perturbation.

articleTitle: Science Monitoring And Reliable Telecommunications (SMART) Cables -- The Future of Global Undersea Observing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: SMART Cables offer revolutionary ocean observing by equipping transoceanic telecommunications cables with sensors, to provide real-time observations such as seafloor temperature, pressure, and seismic signals. They will facilitate research on climate change and sea level rise and enhance earthquake and tsunami early warning efforts.

articleTitle: Spatial Channel Networks and Their Enabling Multicore-Fiber-Based Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper outlines architectures for spatial channel networks and spatial cross-connects. Advances in their building blocks, i.e., core selective switches and core selectors, are also described in terms of increasing the number of cores per port, compact packaging, and polarity management.

articleTitle: Fine-Resolution, Four-Port Optical Interlacer for Subcarrier-Level Optical Front-Haul Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Point-to-multipoint front-haul networks provide shared access to edge sites, with capacity and routing constraints. The front-haul can be empowered using our spatially-diverse point-to-multipoint architecture, introducing sub carrier-level rapid networking and spatial-feeder enhancements. This is achieved with an innovative four-port optical interlacer, increasing capacity and networking flexibility.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifiers for Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review our recent advances in fiber optical parametric amplifiers: demonstrate Mach-Zehnder architecture for polarization-insensitive operation with improved noise figure and reduced nonlinear crosstalk, show reduction of signal penalties due to pump phase modulation, and demonstrate waveband-shift-free optical phase conjugation in a nonlinear optical loop mirror.

articleTitle: Insights and Outcomes from the ASTROMUX Project
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The European Space Agency's HydRON project aims to showcase the world's premier all-optical multi-orbit wavelength division multiplexing network operating at Tb/s capacity. In this framework, the ASTROMUX project focuses on the selection of suitable optical multiplexer/demultiplexers and on testing their performances in challenging space environment.

articleTitle: Design Techniques for Ultra-Compact Low-Loss Multimode Bends
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Multimode bends that prevent mode coupling are designed using three different techniques. Insertion loss <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$< 0.2/0.5 \text{dB}$</tex> for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TE}0/\text{TE}1$</tex> is simulated for compact bend radius of2 μm with crosstalk as low as -35 dB across C-band.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Assembly of a Silicon Photonic 4-Channel Coherent Receiver Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A 4-channel IQ receiver array with individual optical inputs has been fully packaged in an optoelectronic assembly including an RF Rogers PCB, an Alumina PCB as fanout and photonic wire bonds for optical coupling with fiber arrays. BER performance demonstrates potential 240Gbps aggregated data rate.

articleTitle: WD2.4 Broadband Microwave Photonic Filter with Full Reconfigurability and GHz-Level Tuning Speed
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a user-defined time-varying microwave photonic filter for nonstationary signal manipulation, with rapid tuning speed (1.3 GHz), fine resolution (1.3 GHz), and broad frequency bandwidth (>23 GHz). The device features full reconfigurability by electronically programming the spectral response.

articleTitle: Empowering Image Sensors with Integrated Photonic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Developing smarter image sensors for real-time image classification and deep neural network (DNN) acceleration can benefit many applications. This invited paper reviews our recent efforts in deploying silicon photonic neural networks directly on image sensors for near-sensor visual computing with high energy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Signal Regeneration for Flexible Power-Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Robust signal regeneration algorithms are developed that account for polarization demultiplexing and equalization. They are demonstrated to reconstruct power-division multiplexed (PDM) signals with minimal error. The algorithms reconstruct dual polarization 16-QAM experimental data with an average 1.5% waveform error.

articleTitle: The Von Neumann Bottleneck in Photonic Tensor Core Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Reconfigurable photonic circuits have shown promise in high speed and power efficient computations but easily suffer from a memory bottleneck. Here we analyze this bottleneck for a photonic tensor core as well as explore and adapt solutions from digital electronics.

articleTitle: Advances in VCSEL-Based Multimode Links
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Direct modulation at 212.5 Gb/s PAM4 and low power 106.25 Gb/s links are being enabled by advances in 850 nm VCSELs. Open eyes are demonstrated after 30 m OM4 transmission at 212.5 Gb/s. Half-retimed links at 106.25 Gb/s show pre-FEC BER below 1E-8 for trace loss up to 16 dB.

articleTitle: Optical Fi-Wi-Fi Bridge with 32-Port Focal Plane Fiber Array for Robust Waveguide Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: An all-fiber focal plane beamformer with 32 fine-pitched antenna elements and 1×32 switch is employed for robust coupling of light between two optical single-mode waveguides over a free-space link. The penalty in bit error ratio due to an angular receiver misalignment can be fully mitigated.

articleTitle: Empowering AI Workloads in Ultra Ethernet Consortium
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The rapid advancements and widespread enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) have underscored the need to understand the intricacies of AI workloads and their impact on the underlying hardware. This paper discusses the Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC), a coalition focused on optimizing Ethernet architecture to meet the specific demands of AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. Traditional Ethernet, known for its modular OSI layered structure, faces new challenges due to the scale, latency, and reliability requirements imposed by AI. AI workloads are complex and data-intensive, requiring efficient movement between memory, processors, and storage, which magnifies the importance of physical layer trade-offs such as power consumption, temperature stability, and distance effects. The UEC aims to refine the Ethernet stack, particularly the transport layer, to mitigate errors and inefficiencies that can significantly impact AI performance. This paper concludes by emphasizing the necessity for a paradigm shift in engineering practices to accommodate the evolving needs of AI and Ultra Ethernet, advocating for adaptive, interdisciplinary, and innovative approaches.

articleTitle: Multi-Band Transmission Beyond C+L Bands with High-Symbol-Rate WDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper reviews trends in multi-band transmission for >100-Tb/s capacity and presents our results in >1000-km long-haul transmission with high-symbol-rate signals in S+C+L bands. We also introduce a wavelength-conversion technique based on our PPLN waveguide to further extend the WDM bandwidth to S+C+L+U bands.

articleTitle: Transmissive Metasurfaces for Constructing a Magneto-Optical Trap
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A set of transmissive metasurfaces are designed and characterized to construct a six-beam magneto optical trap for neutral strontium atoms. The configuration consists of a polarization-multiplexed metasurface splitter and three topology-optimized metagratings, requiring only two input beams and no bulk optics.

articleTitle: Wideband Spectral Sensing by Integrated Photonics for Signal Separation and Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Wideband spectral sensing (WSS) becomes increasingly critical in the context of growing demands for bandwidth utilization, with photonics addressing the frequency agility chal-lenges faced by traditional radio-frequency (RF) electronics. This paper presents a WSS framework employing integrated photonics for RF signal separation and localization.

articleTitle: Ge-based photonics for quantum technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: in semiconductors play a key role in established technologies. Presently, they are increasingly seen as a novel degree of freedom to tailor the optoelectronic properties of materials and to enable novel device functionalities. Here we utilize optical spectroscopy to characterize the spectral feature attributed to extended defects in p-i-n diodes based on Ge/SiGe MQWs. Specifically, we determined the effective lifetime to be in the hundreads of ns regime and we employ an external bias to demonstrate control over the recombination dynamics.

articleTitle: Optical Signal Recovery for Phase-Agnostic Coherent Reception
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic signal processing is being evaluated for signal recovery in phase-agnostic coherent receivers. Taking advantage of efficient direct-drive translation of photocurrents to the optical frequency domain for subsequent signal processing, the circuit can perform at half the energy cost when compared to RF-based envelope detection.

articleTitle: Gas Flow Behaviour in Hollow Core Fibres under Cryogenic Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We study gas flow behavior within a nested antiresonant hollow core fiber (NANF) when a section of the fiber is under cryogenic conditions. We suggest an effective method to prevent gas flow when preparing all-fibre high-pressure gas NANF cells.

articleTitle: Telescope Arrays for Deep Space Optical Communication: Preliminary Operational Results
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The use of telescope arrays has technical and programmatic advantages for deep space optical communication (DSOC). We have developed the algorithms and architecture for arraying standards-compliant optical signals, and have demonstrated these principles using the Psyche/DSOC instrument and three ground telescopes separated by >100 km.

articleTitle: Bioplausible Photonic-Electronic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic-electronic neural networks employ photonics for high-bandwidth communication and electronics for computing. In this paper we present a programmable photonic-electronic architecture for bioplausible neuromorphic computing to achieve 775±15 spikes/inference corresponding to 915 pJ/inference and 28.6 pJ/inference in the current GF45SPCLO and future 7nm designs, respectively.

articleTitle: MF3.3 Mode-Dependent Gain Estimation Techniques for Coupled Multi-Core Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper reviews four techniques for the estimation of mode-dependent gain in the context of coupled multi-core fiber transmission. Three techniques are based on classical digital signal processing., and one is based on artificial neural networks. We show that artificial networks are promising solutions for practical MDG estimation.

articleTitle: Large Scale MCF production for future SDM networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A large-scale fabrication process is presented based on two 7-core MCF for short reach and long-haul applications, respectively. Measurements indicate very good geometrical and optical performance. The feasibility of industry-level manufacturing of MCF paves the way to economic MCF solutions.

articleTitle: C+L band Distributed Raman Amplification Using Semiconductor Incoherent Forward Pumps
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review characteristics of transmitted optical signals under bidirectionally pumped Raman amplification using semiconductor incoherent light sources as first order forward pumps. Thanks to low intensity noise and wide bandwidth of the forward pumps, the transmitted signals showed low relative intensity noise and high quality.

articleTitle: Modal Generation in Integrated, Programmable Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Modal multiplexing holds great promise for increasing the information density and capacity of optical networks. Integrated silicon photonics offers compact generation of modes, as well as versatility and programmability in the choice of modes.

articleTitle: Integrating MEMS and Silicon-Nitride Photonic Integrated Circuits for Atomic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present the development of optical phased array wide-beam couplers and high extinction ratio modulators to integrating MEMS rubidium vapour cells with a silicon-nitride photonic integrated circuit platform aimed at a range of miniature atomic systems including atomic clocks and cold atom sensors.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Low-Complexity Digital Coherent Receivers for Intra-Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper presents a low-complexity DSP circuit that suits intra-datacenter networks. Its applicability to intra-datacenter networks is confirmed through simulations and experiments using a high-port-count and highly-reliable optical circuit switch tailored for intra-datacenter communications.

articleTitle: Internet Sensor Network Testbeds* *
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Research testbeds to monitor ground-motion vibrations using existing or custom Optical Transport Networks can accelerate development of transceivers with embedded sensing capabilities and be a commons for photonics, seismology, QKD, metrology, telecom, transportation, civil infrastructure, and other research using infrastructure fiber either to monitor or manage environmental signals.

articleTitle: Deep Space Optical Communications from the Psyche Mission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The Deep Space Optical Communications technology demonstration is a hosted payload on the Psyche Mission spacecraft that launched October 2023. Weekly contacts are characterizing the link as the spacecraft moves away from Earth (0.05-2.5 AU) demonstrating a peak 267 Mbps downlink at <0.37 AU.

articleTitle: Self-Homodyne 4-ch WDM 2-ch OTDM Transmission of 64-Gbaud QPSK Signals with Pulsed Carrier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Toward low-energy high-bandwidth Coherent lite, we propose self-homodyne OTDM which utilizes pulsed light as the carrier. The proposed concept is demonstrated in the 4-ch. WDM transmission of 64-Gbaud QPSK signals with CS-RZ optical pulses. The measured BER below 1 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> suggests FEC-free operation of the system.

articleTitle: Toward Cable Response for DAS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We introduce an idealized model of a fiber-optic cable as a cylindrical, layered rod embedded in a uniform wholespace and develop semi-analytical solutions for seismic wave forcing. We then discuss several implications for distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), including Poisson and photoelastic effects.

articleTitle: Hybrid Nanoprinted Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Diffractive neural networks (DNNs) exploit the nature of light propagation in free space and the interaction of a light field with metasurfaces designed with machine learning methods to implement inference passively in the optical domain1. In this way, DNNs can achieve all-optical machine learning tasks such as image classification or decryption2. When nanoprinted with two photon nanolithography (TPN) methods, DNNs can express their full potential achieving a neuron density of >500 million neurons per square centimeter, operative wavelength in the near infrared or visible wavelength regime and on-chip integration with imaging sensors, such as commercial complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) sensors3.

articleTitle: Subcarrier-Based Microring Resonator Weighting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report experimental and simulation results of a weighting scheme that encodes the weight imparted on an RF signal in its modulation frequency. This scheme significantly increases the multiply-accumulate compute density of microring-based Photonic Neural Networks and enables the implementation of large weight matrices.

articleTitle: Non-Uniform Programmable Integrated Photonic Waveguide Hexagonal Mesh
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the design of a non-uniform programmable integrated photonic hexagonal mesh aimed at enhancing the free spectral range of cavities through the Vernier effect. By strategically introducing defects into selected cells, we can increase the free spectral range tenfold.

articleTitle: Emerging Machine Learning Technologies for Photonic Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: To adapt to the steep increases in volume and diversity of communication traffic, machine learning techniques are being intensively studied. This paper overviews the emerging technologies of privacy-centric machine learning and large language models for photonic networks.

articleTitle: On Topology Optimization Enhancements for Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present topology optimization enhancements for thin-film lithium niobate, enabling optimization for structures with nonvertical sidewalls and anisotropic media. We validate our enhancements by optimizing and measuring the first topology optimized polarization demultiplexing grating coupler on thin-film lithium niobate.

articleTitle: Conduction Band Nonparabolicity, Chemical Potential, and Carrier Concentration of Intrinsic InSb as a Function of Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The nonparabolicity of the light hole and electron bands at the Gamma-point in cubic diamond or zinc blende semiconductors is derived from Kane's 8x8 k.p model in the large spin-orbit splitting approximation. To determine the temperature dependence of the effective masses and the nonparabolicity parameters, the unrenormalized band gap must be utilized. This includes only the redshift of the band gap due to thermal expansion, not the renormalization due to deformation potential electron-phonon coupling or polaron effects. As an application of this method, the chemical potential and the charge carrier concentration of intrinsic InSb are calculated from 50 to 800 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$m_{e}^{\ast }$</tex> and compared with electrical and optical experiments. These results are also relevant for other semiconductors with small band gaps needed for mid-infrared detector applications.

articleTitle: Quartz Circular Polarising Optical Window at 80°C for MEMS Vapour Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present the development of on-cell polarisers for use at operating temperature of MEMS vapour cells by accounting for waveplate thickness and birefringence temperature dependence. Implementing on-cell, the SWaP-C of the miniature-atom-interrogation systems reduces. This design-fabrication process is adaptable to other temperatures, wavelengths, and polarisations.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Photonic Integrated Circuits on Sapphire Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Utilizing sapphire as a transformative high-performance PIC platform has been proposed, which enables a fully integrated solution to include a complete set of photonic components and CMOS control circuit. This work presents a feasible study of III-V light sources and waveguides built on sapphire substrate.

articleTitle: Photonic Technologies for Analog Neuromorphic Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic neuromorphic devices promise to break the Von Neumann bottleneck for fast and efficient AI processing. Here we discuss how different photonic technologies affect the performance of analog optical processors, with a focus on microring resonators, where the effect of distortion on resolution is investigated.

articleTitle: A L-Band Quantum Walk Comb Laser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Near-infrared wavelength division multiplexing, facilitated by frequency combs enhance ultra-high-capacity communications and emerging photonic artificial intelligence applications. Leveraging insights from a newly discovered quantum walk comb laser in the mid-infrared, we experimentally demonstrate a novel highly controllable quantum walk comb laser in the near infrared.

articleTitle: Are Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) Secure? A Glance at Security Vulnerabilities in PICs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a study on the impact and mitigation of hardware security attacks in photonic integrated circuits (PICs). Furthermore, we develop a framework for PIC enhanced security with 100 % detection rate and signal integrity improvement.

articleTitle: Detection of Broadband Squeezed Light with a Low-Noise Die-Level Balanced Receiver
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The generation and detection of squeezed light through spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a nonlinear crystal up to a frequency of 3.5 GHz is presented. We characterize the quantum state with balanced homo dyne detection, leveraging a low-noise die-level receiver.
